answer: Sybil resistance bonds each identity in a slashable escrow and links evidence of coordinated equivocation across k identities. Because each implicated pair incurs a penalty, aggregate liability scales as O(k^2), rather than linearly. Detection also applies asymmetric, compounding capital depreciation, imposing an exponential multiplier on a coordinated swarm’s capital loss; dividing stake among sable, forge, or falcon aliases cannot remove that shared exposure.
